title: Alert Push & Multi-Channel Dispatch
description: Configure northbound channels (Webhook & MQTT) for perception event dispatch and periodic device liveness reporting under one shared connection and credential set. Every payload carries the host device_id.
emptyHint: Click 'New Destination' above to create a Webhook or MQTT forwarding and liveness reporting channel.
deleteConfirmDesc: The system will stop dispatching events and liveness reports to this target. This action cannot be undone.

dialog.createDesc: Configure northbound connection credentials and toggle perception event push and/or device liveness reporting.
dialog.editDesc: Modify destination transport, credentials, event filters, and device liveness reporting policy.
dialog.channelLockedNotice: Protocol type cannot be changed after creation. Please create a new destination if needed.
dialog.testTooltip: Immediately send a probe packet (or a real liveness snapshot for heartbeat-only targets) to verify network route and credentials.

capabilities.eventsDesc: Dispatch real-time safety alarms, face matches, and plate recognitions with snapshot delivery
capabilities.heartbeatDesc: Periodically report host readiness, CPU/NPU/thermal watermarks, storage health, and workload summary

sections.imageDeliveryDesc: Control image frame format attached with alert payloads

advanced.filtersAllSummary: Default full dispatch (all events, algorithms and cameras)

fields.name: Channel Name
fields.namePlaceholder: e.g., SOC Webhook, Park Security Platform
fields.heartbeatIntervalHint: 15–3600 seconds (default 60s), with slight jitter to prevent fleet thundering herds
fields.heartbeatUrlPlaceholder: Leave blank to reuse the main Webhook URL above
fields.heartbeatUrlHint: Must share the same origin (scheme, host, and port) as the main Webhook URL when auth or custom headers are configured
fields.heartbeatTopicPlaceholder: Leave blank to reuse the publish topic above, e.g. zhulong/status/box01
fields.heartbeatTopicHint: Used for periodic liveness snapshots and offline notices; wildcards (+ or #) are not allowed
fields.lwtEnabledDesc: Registers a Broker Last Will (publishes connection_lost on power/network loss, and graceful_shutdown on clean stop)
fields.reservedHeaderWarning: This header is reserved by the system and cannot be customized
fields.mqttTopicHint: Target MQTT topic. Wildcards (+ or #) are not allowed
fields.tlsSkipVerifyDesc: Skips Broker TLS certificate verification. Recommended for test environments only
fields.secretRetained: Credential saved; leave empty to keep unchanged

eventTypes.alarmDesc: Intrusion, boundary crossing, loitering and behavioral safety events
eventTypes.face_recognitionDesc: Target list matches, stranger captures and facial feature verification
eventTypes.plate_recognitionDesc: Vehicle structured recognition, license plate reading and list checks

channelTypes.webhookDesc: HTTP POST request with JSON payload or multipart binary attachments to web services or bots
channelTypes.mqttDesc: Lightweight publish-subscribe protocol integration for IoT brokers and message queues

imageModes.urlDesc: Lightweight signed URL with bounded TTL. Target service must access host IP/domain
imageModes.multipartDesc: Raw image bytes uploaded as multipart form data in the same HTTP request
imageModes.base64Desc: Image encoded as Base64 string directly inside JSON payload (≤500KB)

validation.nameMax: Channel name must not exceed 64 characters
validation.capabilityRequired: Enable at least one capability: Perception Event Push or Device Liveness Reporting
validation.heartbeatIntervalRange: Reporting interval must be between 15 and 3600 seconds
validation.heartbeatCrossOrigin: Dedicated Liveness URL must share the same origin (scheme, host, and port) as the main Webhook URL when credentials or custom headers are configured
validation.urlInvalid: URL must start with http:// or https:// and cannot contain userinfo
validation.brokerInvalid: Broker address cannot contain user credentials
validation.topicNoWildcards: Publish topic must not contain wildcards (+ or #)
validation.clientIdMax: Client ID must not exceed 23 characters
validation.reservedHeader: Header "{{key}}" is reserved by the system
